implementation: Derive archetype from the loaded service category; load fixed packages only after the current service resolves.
Filter package results by current service, active status, and fixed price type; reject invalid selected package hints.
Clamp requested quantity to package bounds while preserving valid integer or server-supported fractional quantities.
Bind quote readiness to address identity and eligibility context; only display or submit a quote whose key matches the current context.
Ignore stale service, package, and quote responses after route or context changes.

app: no-hint fixed package loading and package ownership
forged route archetype cannot override the loaded category
quantity maximum clamping and valid integer/fractional preservation
address eligibility change clears readiness, fresh quote failure is visible, and stale address response is ignored
package-switch quote response is stale and cannot enable send
stale service and package responses are ignored after route change
service load and recurring send failures are explicit
recurring, archetype, and category OFF hide new-plan controls
sql: SV-RECURRING-PACKAGE-03: unrelated active package direct quote/create rejected
SV-RECURRING-PACKAGE-03: inactive package direct quote/create rejected
SV-RECURRING-PACKAGE-03: in-bound fractional quantity accepted; above-maximum quantity rejected
